articles.title: Un hijo de Al Thani, dueño del Málaga, deja en Londres un impago de 530.000 euros
articles.standfirst: Nasser Al-Thani, su hijo, acumuló facturas impagadas durante meses
articles.summary: Nasser Al-Thani, su hijo, acumuló facturas impagadas durante meses
articles.body: El jeque catarí Nasser Al-Thani, hijo del mayor accionista del Málaga CF, Abdullah Al-Thani, ha dejado un impago de 458.000 libras (532.000 euros) en un hotel de lujo de Londres, y hoy un tribunal ha autorizado al establecimiento a requisar y vender un coche que el jeque dejó en sus instalaciones. El diario británico Financial Times, que recoge el fallo judicial, señala que el impago es por el alojamiento y servicio de habitaciones, más intereses. Teniendo en cuenta que en ese hotel las habitaciones cuestan un máximo de 8.000 libras (más de 9.300 euros) por noche, significa que las facturas impagadas se acumularon durante meses. El coche que ahora podrá vender el Hotel Dorchester, en el barrio exclusivo de Mayfair, es un Fiat 500 Abarth Tributo Ferrari, que tiene un valor de venta en foros de segunda mano de solo 23.500 libras (unos 30.000 euros), muy lejos del valor de la deuda. El jeque no asistió a las vistas judiciales, y sus abogados dijeron al rotativo que su cliente "tomará medidas para desestimar ese caso", pero por sus palabras se deduce que no niega que existiera el impago. El paso del jeque Abdullah Al-Thani por el fútbol español ha sido turbulento: el pasado 6 de julio, el Juzgado de Instrucción número 14 de Málaga dictó una orden de búsqueda y detención europea e ingreso en prisión en su contra y en contra de sus hijos Nayef, Naser y Rakan, debido a la causa abierta por los presuntos delitos de apropiación indebida, administración desleal e imposición de acuerdos abusivos. En el auto, enviado a todas las partes personadas en la causa, se acuerda "la prisión provisional de los imputados en las presentes actuaciones, no conociéndose actualmente su real paradero".

articles.title: Fenerbahçe y Roma firman el empate en su retorno a Champions
articles.standfirst: Ambos equipos empiezan sumando en un partido muy entretenido
articles.summary: Ambos equipos empiezan sumando en un partido muy entretenido
articles.body: Un duelo de retornos que dejó contentos a ambos equipos. El Fenerbahçe regresaba a Champions casi dos décadas después, la Roma tras siete años de ausencia. Y ambos empataron (1-1) en Estambul en un partido divertídisimo con ocasiones para ambos equipos. Cristante hizo el 0-1 y Brown empató justo tras iniciar la segunda parte. La Roma no titubeó en Estambul y demostró que el brillante inicio de Serie A no es casualidad. Si bien el Fenerbahçe tuvo las primeras ocasiones, con Svilar respondiendo con seguridad, no tardó el equipo de Gasperini en hacerse con la llave del partido y encerrar a los turcos bajo su propia portería. El primero en avisar fue Dybala y, pasada la media hora, Cristante fulminó a Éderson con un potente disparo desde fuera del área tras una gran jugada de Malen. Pero todo cambió tras el descanso. El partido se convirtió en un tiroteo que aprovecharon los otomanos. En la primera acción del segundo tiempo, Archie Brown marcaba aprovechando un gran pase de Greenwood y un despiste defensivo de la Roma. Todo se igualaba y arrancaron los minutos de frenesí local que únicamente pudo frenar Mile Svilar. El propio Greenwood y Muriqi tuvieron ocasiones para haber remontado. Pero el meta serbio estuvo enorme. La Roma, sin embargo, se recuperó. Y aunque Skriniar tuvo un remate al larguero, 'La Loba' supo controlar el partido y aguantar el resultado. Un empate (1-1) que sirve a ambos equipos para iniciar la Champions League sumando.

articles.title: Dest neutraliza al Shakhtar de Arda Turan
articles.standfirst: Ni el PSV ni los ucranianos acumularon demasiados méritos para ganar
articles.summary: Ni el PSV ni los ucranianos acumularon demasiados méritos para ganar
articles.body: Reparto de puntos en el Philips Stadion. Ni el PSV ni el Shakhtar Donetsk de Arda Turan hicieron demasiado por llevarse los puntos... y se tuvieron que conformar con un empate (1-1) en su estreno en la Champions League. El primer tiempo no tuvo demasiada historia. El Shakhtar Donetsk se adueñó de la posesión, intentando salir desde atrás. Hubo que esperar 19' para ver el primer tiro a puerta. Fue para el PSV, que dejó en el banquillo al español Yarek Gasiorowski. Lo protagonizó Kodai Sano, buen partido el suyo, y acabó en las manos de Dmytro Riznyk. Ya en el añadido, llegó el 0-1. No sin polémica. Marlon Gomes se llevó por delante el balón y a Sergiño Dest antes de que la jugada cayera en los pies de Gleiker Mendoza. El internacional venezolano recibió abierto a la izquierda, encaró a Lutsharel Geertruida, se abrió hueco y batió a Matej Kovář con un disparo al palo largo. Dest se vengó en el 48', nada más salir del descanso. Ruben van Bommel, muy incisivo, cedió para Armando Obispo y éste detectó la llegada del ex del Barcelona en la frontal. Ahí Dest no perdonó. Metió el interior y la colocó pegada al palo, lejos del alcance de Riznyk. Es curioso. El internacional estadounidense, a pesar de jugar de lateral, es el 'Pichichi' del PSV en lo que va de curso con tres dianas, las mismas que Ricardo Pepi. Rozó el triunfo el Shakhtar en el 82'. Lo evitó... el omnipresente ¡Dest! Oleh Ocheretko prolongó de cabeza para Lassina Traoré y el ex del Barça se cruzó 'in extremis' para evitar el remate a bocajarro del burkinés.

articles.title: Agoumé, el puntal silencioso del Sevilla
articles.standfirst: El centrocampista francés, halagado por Luis García Plaza, destaca en varios registros en este arranque liguero
articles.summary: El centrocampista francés, halagado por Luis García Plaza, destaca en varios registros en este arranque liguero
articles.body: En la antesala de la quinta jornada de LaLiga EA Sports, en la que el Sevilla recibirá al Valencia en el Ramón Sánchez-Pizjuán, Luis García Plaza ha hablado acerca de varios nombres propios del conjunto hispalense. Entre ellos, se encuentra un futbolista de perfil silencioso, pero cuya trascendencia e impacto sobre el césped vienen creciendo de manera exponencial partido tras partido: Lucien Agoumé. El mediocentro, que afronta su cuarto curso en Nervión, ha pasado de ser una apuesta de futuro a convertirse en el termómetro de su equipo. Agoumé ha partido como titular en los cuatro encuentros que ha disputado el Sevilla hasta la fecha. De hecho, se trata de uno de los cuatro integrantes de la plantilla que han disputado todos los minutos posibles, junto con el guardameta Odysseas Vlachodimos y los defensas Juan Iglesias y Gabriel Suazo. No solo ha sabido adaptarse perfectamente a lo que le pide Luis García Plaza, sino que se ha ganado su plena confianza como su ancla táctica sobre el terreno de juego. En los últimos meses, Lucien Agoumé está mostrando una clara evolución en conceptos del juego como el posicionamiento o la anticipación. Cuestionado por ello en rueda de prensa, Luis García Plaza no ha escatimado en halagar el buen momento de forma que atraviesa. "Muy bien, lo estoy viendo muy bien también. Hablo mucho con él. Es un chaval que desde que llegué le dije que quería que fuese importante para mí y hasta ahora lo está siendo", aseveró. "Creo que ya terminó bien el año pasado. De los nueve partidos en los que estuve yo, en alguno no estuvo tan bien, pero en general rindió a un gran nivel. Por ejemplo, se me viene a la cabeza su partido en Villarreal, que fue espectacular", continuó el entrenador madrileño recordando aquella agónica recta final de liga. El jugador francocamerunés no pudo estar en su primer partido ante el Oviedo por sanción, pero aun así participó siete jornadas a sus órdenes, cinco de ellas como titular. Además, García Plaza quiso enfatizar el rol de Agoumé como uno de los principales líderes futbolísticos de este nuevo Sevilla: "Este año está jugando muy bien, para mí es uno de los puntales del equipo. Siempre digo que cuando encuentras esos puntales, ahora lo que tienen que hacer es mantener el rendimiento. He hablado de Kike Salas, he hablado de Luci y para mí son dos jugadores muy importantes. Creo que está a un nivel alto", subrayó el técnico. Lucien Agoumé destaca en datos estadísticos que lo sitúan entre los mejores recuperadores de estas cuatro primeras jornadas. El centrocampista acumula el tercer mejor registro de LaLiga en intercepciones con un total de 10, solo superado por Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) y Beñat Gerenabarrena (Athletic Club). Asimismo, ocupa la segunda posición en el ranking de entradas exitosas con 11, únicamente por detrás de Manu Sánchez (Levante). A ello suma 12 despejes, 22 duelos ganados o 10 faltas cometidas, un recurso que, administrado con criterio según el contexto del partido, resulta crucial para equilibrar el sistema defensivo. La exhibición de Agoumé en el encuentro contra el Espanyol sirvió como paradigma de su madurez. En Cornellà dominó el tempo del juego dándole fluidez a la circulación -fue el sevillista que acaparó más posesión - y ofreció varios destellos en el último pase. Sin embargo, lo más llamativo fuera seguramente la mejora en la lectura defensiva. Ante la falta de un gran pico de velocidad, ha desarrollado una buena intuición espacial para saltar a la anticipación y luego orquestar los contragolpes, volviendo así a una posición que le resulta más natural. Con vistas al duelo frente al Valencia, Luis García Plaza podría introducir modificaciones en la medular del Sevilla. Futbolistas como Giorgi Kochorashvili, Youssouf Fofana o Jon Guridi opositan a formar parte del centro del campo titular. No obstante, en este momento solo Agoumé resulta inamovible, pues se ha erigido en uno de los pilares sobre el que se edifica el nuevo proyecto.

articles.title: Premier League predictions: Chris Sutton v Dorking Wanderers manager Marc White - & AI
articles.summary: BBC Sport football expert Chris Sutton takes on Dorking Wanderers manager Marc White, plus the BBC readers and AI with his predictions for this weekend's Premier League fixtures.
articles.body:
New Manchester City boss Enzo Maresca has made a table-topping start, but will his 100% Premier League record survive Sunday's short trip to Old Trafford?

"Marcus Rashford is fit and has looked a threat when I've seen him play," said BBC Sport football expert Chris Sutton. "Because of that, I can see Manchester United scoring.

"But United have conceded twice against Hull, Ipswich and Everton , so why wouldn't they ship goals against City too?"

Sutton is making predictions for all 380 Premier League games this season, against AI, BBC Sport readers and a variety of guests.

For week four, he takes on Dorking Wanderers manager Marc White.

White's story as founder, player and manager of his own club was the subject of a docuseries, , external which racked up more than half a billion views by the end of 2025. You can also follow his strategies and insights on TikTok. , external

Do you agree with Sutton and White's scores? You can pick your own below.

The most popular scoreline selected for each game is used in the scoreboards and tables at the bottom of this page.

A correct result (picking a win, draw or defeat) is worth 10 points. The exact score earns 40 points.

Want to make more predictions? You can play BBC Sport's new Match of the Day predictor game every week, featuring six fixtures from domestic and European competitions.

Seeing his club win a place in the Football League remains the aim for White, but reaching the Premier League feels a far more distant dream.

"For me the gulf in football is between the Premier League and some Championship clubs, and the rest," White told BBC Sport.

"The Premier League is still the elite place to be, and it's like being part of a financial institution when you are there, but you need to spend your money wisely.

"One big theory I have, if you flip it around the other way, is you would not want to get relegated from the Premier League.

"There are clubs in there, like Fulham or Bournemouth and Brentford , where arguably there are much bigger clubs than them in the Championship.

"That next manager is always so important for clubs of that size because, if they get it wrong and go down, some of them may never come back.

"The Championship is a little bit divided too. We do a lot of business with Charlton Athletic, and their finances, compared to the majority of that division, are nothing. There's no comparison between them and West Ham, for example. They are miles apart.

"Beyond that, there is not such a gap, but you can definitely put a thick border between the Championship and League One.

"I think that's why you see the likes of Bromley and Stockport go on the same journey from non-league that we are trying to make, and go up from League Two too. But then they get to League One and it is like the next bit is the tough bit."

Chris Sutton and Marc White were speaking to BBC Sport's Chris Bevan.

The AI predictions were generated using Microsoft Copilot Chat - we simply asked the tool to 'predict this weekend's Premier League scores'.

This is a hard one to start with because, while Aston Villa still haven't won or scored in the Premier League, they got a good win over Club Brugge in the Champions League on Tuesday.

Nicolas Jackson got off the mark in that game and, although his finishing can be erratic, he's the kind of player who will mature and get better every season. I think he will do well for them.

Forest are also yet to win. I know there was controversy over Neco Williams' disallowed goal in their draw against Spurs last time out but I do think they got the decision right in the end.

This is going to be close and I am tempted to go for another Forest draw, but Villa are obviously going to score in the Premier League at some point so I'll be brave and say they will edge it.

Marc's prediction: Villa have been turned inside-out over the summer, but they fall into that category of having a great manager and Unai Emery will stabilise them. 1-1

To say Bournemouth keep on throwing it away is a bit harsh, but they have been ahead in all three of their league games so far and have not won any of them.

Will they see this one through? I am not sure, but I like the way Cherries boss Marco Rose talks when he has been interviewed after games. He is a bright guy and he will get things right.

I was spot on with my prediction for Brentford 's 1-1 draw with Sunderland last week, but the Bees were actually lucky to get a point in the end.

Brentford will play on the counter-attack here and Bournemouth will have a go at them, so this smells like a draw to me.

Marc's prediction: It's mad to think this was a League Two fixture in 2009, when Bournemouth almost went out of the Football League. With Brentford , it could be just a matter of time before Keith Andrews is seen as a manager who is desired by the big clubs. If he has another good season, someone will be in for him. 1-2

I have happy memories of this fixture because one of my three goals for Chelsea came against Hull, in the FA Cup.

Hull haven't conceded yet and they are the team I have been most wrong about so far this season.

With every passing week, they are putting more egg on my face [see the table based on Sutton's predictions at the bottom of the page] but it can't keep happening, can it?

It probably can, but I am still going for Chelsea to win this. The Tigers have defended brilliantly so far, but they are not going to keep out Cole Palmer, Morgan Rogers and Joao Pedro.

Hull will defend ferociously but, as Chelsea showed in the Carabao Cup against Leeds on Wednesday, they have enough quality to play through teams who sit in; and, if they score first, then Hull will have to open up - that's my theory anyway.

The only thing I was unsure about was whether Hull would score too. Chelsea still seem to be a bit chaotic with the way they defend, and they have leaked a few goals, but I have given them a clean sheet. They need one.

Marc's prediction: It's a bit like Beauty and the Beast, this. Hull will be quite happy to be the beast, but there are some games where that won't work. With Chelsea 's front-line, this is one of them. 4-0

Crystal Palace picked up their first win under Pierre Sage last weekend, which was really important for them.

They have still got goals in their team, as they showed against Fulham , but it was quite an open game and they always look like they will concede a few too.

I covered Ipswich's defeat by Liverpool and what worries me a little bit is the way their manager Gary O'Neil saw that game.

He was overly positive about his team's performance and, while I know why he is doing it, you can't mask that they didn't match Liverpool and they were not creative enough in the final third either - I don't remember Alisson having to make a save of note.

This feels like an important game for Ipswich after two successive defeats but I don't know why I am thinking they will get a point because that's not going to happen, is it?

My first thought was that they will grind out a draw, but I've changed my mind and am going with Palace to take the points at home.

Marc's prediction: Palace are in the bracket of clubs who might be in trouble this year, but I have put this down as a draw because they have got that Selhurst Park thing going on. 1-1

I am covering this game for 5 Live and will be co-commentating with Ian Dennis.

For Fulham , the big talking point is their manager, and whether they will sink any lower under Alvaro Arbeloa. He will be under pressure until he gets his first Premier League win.

Fulham look a little bit lightweight to me and, while Cesar Palacios in midfield and Gonzalo Garcia up front have clearly got something about them, it is always going to be hard for any young player to hit the ground running when they are thrown into the Premier League, especially under a manager who is new too.

If you don't get off to a good start, you are going to be scrutinised. It is the same for every manager and, while Fulham have got some good attacking players, they are shipping goals at the other end.

To lead twice against Palace, who had also started the season poorly, and still lose makes this game even bigger for Arbeloa.

He is trying to play a high pressing game, and he also wants to dominate the ball, but at the highest level, which the Premier League is, if you are not on point with your press then teams will play through you.

Arbeloa needs a result to kickstart his season, or at least something to grab hold of, and I don't think it's impossible for them to get something at Anfield.

I certainly don't think Liverpool have cracked it after watching them win at Ipswich, and they will give up some chances with their high defensive line too.

Fulham will score, but the problem for Arbeloa is that Liverpool will score more.

Marc on why he follows Fulham : I went to watch Fulham as a really small kid, which was my first memory of 'big' football, standing on the terrace at Craven Cottage, and I still go there now whenever we're not playing. I am friends with the captain, Tom Cairney, so luckily I get to watch them quite a lot. They are quite a unique family club at that level and I really enjoy it, plus it's a good chance to watch Premier League football.

Marc's prediction: Fulham have done the opposite of what Brentford did when Thomas Frank left. They don't just have a new manager to replace Marco Silva, they have a new system and with new players. It's a big gamble. 3-1

This is absolutely massive for Tottenham boss Roberto de Zerbi. First and foremost, though, he needs to take a bit of responsibility for his side's poor results.

He blamed the Spurs strikers after their 0-0 draw with Nottingham Forest , but at least he has got some in his squad.

I just find it wild that in a billion-dollar industry, which football is now, Everton got themselves in a position where they let Beto leave, knowing there was a possibility that Folarin Balogun might fail his medical and without having anyone else lined up.

Could they still go to Spurs and nick something? Absolutely. I am still not sure whether Tottenham being at home counts as an advantage.

But this game has a draw written all over it, and is actually an easy game to predict.

Spurs are a 'law of averages' team, or at least that's the way I see it. Eventually they have to score and eventually they have to win too, but I don't see both things happening this weekend.

Marc's prediction: Spurs have a new team but continue to frustrate their fans, while Everton just seem to go about their business. 2-2

This was a cracking game last season, which finished 2-2, and is arguably Arsenal 's toughest test so far in this campaign.

I really like Sunderland and their European campaign has not started yet so those extra games won't affect them here.

I feel like being brave and giving them a draw because they are well capable of taking a point off Arsenal , but the Gunners just have the ability to shut up shop when they need to, and they can get physical again if they need to.

Thinking about it, I can't really go against an Arsenal victory, because of the players they were able to bring on in last weekend's comeback win against Chelsea .

They have got A-list replacements everywhere they look and, if they need a goal against Sunderland , I can see them bringing someone on to get them one.

Marc's prediction: I'm a bit worried about Sunderland this season. They had a lot of momentum last year, and they also made a really good start. 1-3

Coventry played well against Manchester City and should have got something from the game, but didn't.

I can see them going toe-to-toe with Brighton , but it's dangerous to think they will get something this week just because they troubled Man City.

Brighton are a naturally attacking side, with some very good players. It will be hard to keep them out.

Marc's prediction: Clubs like Brighton are very astute. They know that these are the games to win - that's where their points come from. 0-2

I have got this result really badly wrong over the past couple of seasons, when I have tended to go for City, but I am not sure this time.

City are more methodical under Enzo Maresca, with the way that he builds play from the back - they won't be swashbuckling, put it that way.

I don't think he has changed much about his way of playing from when he was in charge at Chelsea , and United will be ready for that.

I really like United boss Michael Carrick and the way he does not get too carried away, win or lose.

Everton 's late equaliser would have felt like a loss last weekend, but United still haven't clicked in attack yet, and that's part of the problem for them.

Then I look at the goals they are shipping too, and wonder if they are really good enough to keep City out?

I am not so sure they are, but I also think they can hurt City.

City have made a brilliant start, with four wins out of four in all competitions since the Premier League got under way, but if they looked a little vulnerable against Coventry then United are going to cause them more problems.

Marc's prediction: I think I know the way this is going for United. Carrick has had that natural bounce that a former player is going to get but, long term, sustaining that is tough. For me, he could become a manager under pressure this year.

With City, it's a sign of a good manager for them to start like this under Maresca. I have them down as clear winners here. 0-2

Newcastle are the new counter-attack kings and I am expecting more of the same from them here.

It will be interesting to see how Leeds boss Daniel Farke tries to deal with that. He has been quite versatile with the way he has set his side up this season.

Leeds have shown a bit more steel in their league games too, and look well organised, but at the same time I don't know if they carry as much of an attacking threat as they did previously.

I probably still fancy Leeds more to win this because they are at home, but Newcastle showed plenty of fight against Bournemouth last week and this will probably end up in a draw too.

Marc's prediction: A Monday night thriller. 2-3

As Chris said after a successful week two, "it's not how you start the weekend, it's how you finish it".

It was the final few fixtures which decided the outcome this time too - only it wasn't Chris who took the victory in week three.

He was leading on Saturday night after eight of the weekend's 10 games had been played, but his guest, Kasabian frontman Serge Pizzorno, enjoyed a 'Super Sunday' with exact scores in both remaining games to snatch the overall win.

Chris ended up with six correct results, including one exact score, for a total of 90 points.

That was enough to beat the BBC readers, who managed four correct results with one exact score for a tally of 70 points, and also AI, which got three correct results and one exact score, giving it 60 points.

It was Serge who surged to victory, however, after correctly predicting Everton 's 2-2 draw with Manchester United and Arsenal 's 2-1 win over Chelsea .

He got four correct results but those two exact scores proved decisive, giving him a winning total of 100 points.

Everyone was right about only two of the fixtures - Liverpool 's win at Ipswich and Manchester City 's victory over Coventry.

There were three fixtures where none of our predictors picked the right outcome - the draws in Newcastle - Bournemouth and Brighton - Leeds , and Crystal Palace 's 3-2 win at Fulham .

From more than 37,000 predictions, only around 5,000 (14%) went for any sort of Palace win, and only 79 of you got the correct scoreline.

articles.title: Richarlison: Brazil striker and Tottenham Hotspur in dispute over contract
articles.summary: Tottenham and their forward Richarlison are in dispute over the remaining nine months on his contract.
articles.body:
Tottenham and their Brazil forward Richarlison are in dispute over the remaining nine months on his contract.

Richarlison, whose proposed deadline day move to Everton broke down, is understood to be exploring his options with sources indicting the 29-year-old is keen to be released from the remainder of his deal.

Talks between the club and player's representatives are ongoing to find a resolution but it is believed the matter has escalated in recent days.

While Richarlison is eager to reach an agreement with Tottenham which would allow him to walk away from the club for nothing, Spurs are not considering that option as realistic.

To complicate matters, Spurs have a 12-month option to extend Richarlison's contract until the end of next season.

Spurs are unwilling to negotiate a settlement with Richarlison over the rest of his deal.

The attacker has been left out of the club's Premier League squad after the Everton move collapsed.

Tottenham were in line to earn £35m, but the forward failed to agree personal terms with the Toffees.

Brazilian side Vasco de Gama would like to sign Richarlison, with the forward believed to be keen to return to his homeland.

articles.title: Pedrerol, muy duro con los pitos del Bernabéu: "Algunos no han asumido que han perdido las elecciones"
articles.standfirst: El comunicador y periodista, muy contundente en Radio MARCA
articles.summary: El comunicador y periodista, muy contundente en Radio MARCA
articles.body: El periodista y comunicador, Josep Pedrerol, celebró su cumpleaños junto a Vicente Ortega en Radio MARCA. 'El Chiringuito' desembarcó hace ya semanas en su nueva casa, Mediaset. "Con el cambio he rejuvenecido diez años. Estamos muy ilusionados porque está siendo muy bonito", comentó. Pedrerol aprovechó además para repasar algunos temas de la actualidad futbolística como el arranque de temporada que está viviendo el Barça, que sueña con la Champions. "El Barça juega de memoria, es una maravilla verlos jugar, pero el tema es si seguirá siendo tan competitivo cuando avance la Champions. Esto no es cómo empieza sino cómo acaba", explicó. Especialmente contundente se mostró a la hora de hablar sobre los pitos que el Santiago Bernabéu dedicó el pasado miércoles contra el Inter y que ya se repitieron en varias ocasiones en la temporada pasada. "¿Qué pasa en el Bernabéu? Las elecciones han provocado que algunos que han perdido no hayan asumido la derrota. Va a ser perjudicial para el equipo. ¿Por qué hay interés por parte de algunos en que al equipo le vaya mal? No entiendo que haya gente que va predispuesta a pitar e incluso a insultar. Aquí no es ser de Mourinho o contra Mourinho, de Florentino o contra Florentino, el que es del Madrid es del Madrid. Hay que apoyar al equipo y pitar a los jugadores cuando acabe el encuentro", reflexionó. Faltan aún semanas para que en Londres se elija al mejor jugador del 2026, pero el debate sobre quién lo merece o quién lo debe ganar ya está instalado en todos los equipos con candidatos a ganarlo. Pedrerol reflexionó sobre el asunto en 'El Programa de Ortega'. "Es un Balón de Oro de perfil bajo. Lamine no ha hecho un gran mundial, pero ha ganado títulos, Mbappé ha hecho un gran Mundial, pero no ha ganado...Esto es marketing. Veo que Mbappé ha sido el mejor por goles y que Messi es Messi", señaló.

articles.title: Vargas viaja a Madrid para revisar su rodilla
articles.standfirst: El suizo busca una segunda opinión médica mientras Luis García Plaza aguarda su regreso
articles.summary: El suizo busca una segunda opinión médica mientras Luis García Plaza aguarda su regreso
articles.body: El calvario físico de Rubén Vargas suma un nuevo capítulo. Después de un verano convulso en el que su nombre estuvo con frecuencia en la rampa de salida, el internacional suizo continúa sin poder ponerse a las órdenes de Luis García Plaza. Tal como ha adelantado Zona Mixta, el futbolista del Sevilla ha viajado esta mañana a Madrid para someterse a una revisión médica especializada en su rodilla derecha, ya que no terminan de desaparecer los dolores que arrastra en la articulación. La pasada semana, los servicios médicos del Sevilla diagnosticaron que Vargas padecía una parameniscitis externa en la rodilla afectada, una inflamación en los tejidos blandos adyacentes al menisco. Desde la entidad hispalense confiaban en que solo fuera una dolencia leve, planeando su reincorporación a la dinámica grupal durante los últimos días. Sin embargo, las sensaciones del jugador helvético no han sido positivas, motivando este desplazamiento a la capital para recabar una segunda opinión. La ausencia de Vargas supone un contratiempo para los planes de Luis García Plaza, ya que no podrá contar con él al menos hasta después del parón internacional. El entrenador madrileño no dudó en respaldarlo públicamente y reafirmar su apuesta por recuperarlo para la causa: "Estoy esperando a que podamos tirar para adelante con él porque me gusta disponer de todos. Para mí es un jugador importante. Se lo he transmitido a él desde que llegué. Hay que recuperar su mejor versión y darle toda la confianza".

articles.title: Mbappé: "Un jugador que marca goles nunca será un problema en un equipo"
articles.standfirst: En una entrevista con France Football, el delantero sale al paso de las críticas
articles.summary: En una entrevista con France Football, el delantero sale al paso de las críticas
articles.body: Mbappé ha concedido una entrevista a 'France Football' de la que ha trascendido una mínima parte. En ella, la estrella del Real Madrid habla de cuestiones de actualidad que están en el ambiente de la crítica. La primera, las acusaciones sobre su compromiso defensivo: "Creo que no es normal, pero es la vida de alguien que ha estado cerca de la excelencia durante años. Todo el mundo sabe desde hace años lo que puedo hacer. Y creo que ahí es donde entras en el marco humano. Es humano mirar siempre lo que alguien no está haciendo. Cuando lleva 10 años haciéndolo, ya no miramos lo que hace. Así que siempre intentamos fijarnos en lo que él no hace. A partir de ese momento, no es algo que me lo tome como algo personal", apunta Mbappé. El delantero no entiende que la gran cantidad de goles que marca puedan generar controversia y que haya gente que piense que es negativo, que su estratosférico rendimiento individual va en contra del grupo. "Es un discurso que tiene menos sentido, porque si no marco, la gente me preguntará por qué no marco. Después aprendí que, cuando eres futbolista, en cada partido que juegas, hay millones de entrenadores. Y no todos los entrenadores son felices en casa. Cada uno tiene su propio punto de vista, pero creo que el objetivo del fútbol es marcar goles, marcar uno más que el rival. Un jugador que marca goles nunca será un problema en un equipo, porque nunca he visto a un equipo ganar títulos por no marcar ningún gol", defiende Mbappé. Por último, sobre las críticas, se muestra tranquilo: "Creo que tengo una relación justa con la crítica. Porque hay críticas constructivas y críticas un poco más absurdas. No es algo que me asuste cuando tengo que tomar una decisión. No creo que vayan a ser criticado. Si sé que, para mí, es la decisión correcta, o que puede que no sea la correcta pero es necesaria, creo que mi historial lo ha demostrado: voy adelante sin rodeos".

articles.title: Iowa Announces Tributes Honoring Marching Band Member Derek Phillips for Week 2 Game vs. ISU
articles.summary: The Iowa marching band will honor member Derek Phillips, who died Tuesday after collapsing during the season-opening game against Northern Illinois, during Saturday's upcoming contest against Iowa State.
articles.body:
The Iowa marching band will honor member Derek Phillips, who died Tuesday after collapsing during the season-opening game against Northern Illinois, during Saturday's upcoming contest against Iowa State.

The Hawkeye Marching Band announced it will honor Phillips "in several ways," including keeping the leader position of the H1 squad empty for the rest of the 2026 campaign.

The band will also spell out his name on the field at halftime and wear black ribbons in his honor. There will be a moment of silence at the game as well.

Phillips' family announced on Instagram he suffered "sudden cardiac arrest" during the game. They also said they made the "heartbreaking decision to remove" him from life support.

"Despite the extraordinary efforts of the ICU team at the University of Iowa Hospital, the damage to his brain was too severe, and we have made the heartbreaking decision to remove life support," the family said. "... Derek is comfortable, surrounded by family, and enveloped in the music he loved so much. Thank you for every prayer, every shared experience, and every bit of love you've given to our boy."

In the band's initial statement , it said, "Derek Phillips was our mellophone section leader, a beloved member of the School of Music horn studio, and the kind of friend, student, and musician that represents the very best of what it means to be a Hawkeye."

Iowa faces Iowa State on Saturday at 7:30 p.m. ET.

articles.title: El entrenador del Fenerbahçe dimite tras empatar con la Roma "con la condición de no regresar jamás"
articles.standfirst: Ismail Kartal pone fin, por sorpresa, a su cuarta etapa al frente del club
articles.summary: Ismail Kartal pone fin, por sorpresa, a su cuarta etapa al frente del club
articles.body: El turco Ismail Kartal ha dimitido del cargo de entrenador del Fenerbahce después del empate en Champions League contra la Roma (1-1), apenas tres meses después de regresar al club, una decisión inesperada que generó sorpresa. Kartal tomó la palabra al término del encuentro y, antes de anunciar su salida, felicitó a sus jugadores por el resultado. "Estoy orgulloso de mis jugadores y los felicito. Ahora, sin aceptar preguntas, quiero hablar un poco sobre mí", comenzó. "Llevo aquí tres meses. Desde el comienzo de la temporada hasta hoy, nuestros entrenamientos y concentraciones con los jugadores, así como nuestro presidente y nuestros directivos, trataron de ayudarnos en todo. Fueron días muy bonitos", explicó. Y anunció su decisión: "A partir de esta noche, felicito a mis jugadores y renuncio a mi cargo". "No aceptaré preguntas. Esta noche he dejado mi cargo. He tomado esta decisión para allanar el camino a mi club; la tomamos junto con nuestro equipo", señaló tajante. Kartal añadió que había decidido marcharse para ayudar al Fenerbahce y a sus futbolistas durante los próximos entrenamientos. "He presentado mi dimisión mientras aún estaba a tiempo", afirmó. El técnico cerró su intervención con una despedida rotunda: "Les deseo a todos una buena noche, con la condición de no regresar jamás". Kartal había sido anunciado el pasado 18 de junio como nuevo entrenador del Fenerbahce, con un contrato por una temporada. Su regreso suponía su cuarta etapa al frente del conjunto de Estambul, después de haber dirigido al equipo en las temporadas 2014-2015, 2021-2022 y 2023-2024. Su dimisión llega después de un inicio en la Superliga turca en la que consiguió dos victorias y dos empates, y en la misma noche en la que el Fenerbahce regresaba a la máxima competición continental tras dieciocho años. El equipo había alcanzado la fase de liga de la Liga de Campeones tras superar las eliminatorias previas y empató este jueves ante la Roma tras disputar una buena segunda parte.

articles.title: Tebas destaca el "esfuerzo" del Sevilla por equilibrar las cuentas
articles.standfirst: Elogios del presidente de LaLiga y de Javier Gómez, director general corporativo, a la gestión
articles.summary: Elogios del presidente de LaLiga y de Javier Gómez, director general corporativo, a la gestión
articles.body: Después de que LaLiga publicara la última actualización de los límites salariales de cada equipo, Javier Tebas, presidente, y Javier Gómez, director general corporativo, comparecieron ante los medios para explicar la situación económica de los clubes y de la competición en general. Ambos ha hablando muy positivamente del trabajo que viene realizando el Sevilla en este aspecto. "Destacaría el esfuerzo que están haciendo con la cuenta de resultados, por equilibrarlo. Recalcar el por qué, eran muchos años seguidos jugando la Champions y eran muchos ingresos más por temporada, le permitía tener unas masas salariales muy elevadas. Cuando dejas de jugar la Champions, no tienes esos ingresos y los jugadores siguen cobrando lo mismo. Es un problema estructural del fútbol europeo, que lo vengo denunciando", comentaba. Y añadía: "Aquellos clubes que juegan competición europea y lo dejan de jugar, entran en problemas económicos. Habrá que inventar algo, nosotros lo hacemos con la ayuda al descenso. Para mí no es un problema de gestión del club, es un problema estructural de cuando juegas competición europea muchos años. Los ingresos no solo es televisión, son también de taquilla que también son importantes". Por su parte, Javier Gómez señaló: "Esta temporada 26-27 va a estar muy cercano si no dentro ya del equilibrio, no tener pérdida. Si miramos las últimas temporadas ha tenido 140 millones de pérdida. Esas pérdidas es un poco lo que le pasó al Barcelona, es una carga que tiene el club y que la va a seguir llevando hasta que no vaya recuperando y reequilibrando esas pérdidas que ha tenido esos cuatro años. Es lo que le pasa al Sevilla. No jugar competición europea es como un descenso de categoría". El club nervionense sigue trabajando para regenerarse tras caerse de la Champions y presentar un déficit histórico en la 23/24, su último año Champions. El equipo ha conseguido mantenerse en Primera, ha reducido considerablemente el gasto en plantilla -ahora es sostenible desde el punto de vista financiero-, también los gastos operativos y cada vez está más cerca de volver a equilibrar las cuentas, dejando la deuda neta actualmente, en la que se incluyen los préstamos, en 60 millones. "Cuando tomé posesión del cargo uno de los objetivos prioritarios era cuadrar cuentas. En los últimos 24 meses hemos reducidos los gastos de 265 a 135 millones de euros. Hemos estado dos temporadas donde hemos sufrido mucho en lo deportivo y teníamos que buscar plantillas más eficientes donde todo el dinero que gastemos tenga la camiseta del Sevilla y juegue en el Sevilla. Gracias al acierto de nuestro director deportivo y de nuestro entrenador sacando rendimiento a la plantilla, queremos no sufrir y asentar las bases del futuro Sevilla", comentó recientemente el presidente José María del Nido Carrasco.

articles.title: Jamal Musiala scores in Champions League for Bayern Munich weeks after seizures
articles.summary: After struggling with seizures on the field, Jamal Musiala celebrated his first goal of the season by pointing to his head.  Musiala scored the opening goal...
articles.body:
MUNICH (AP) — After struggling with seizures on the field, Jamal Musiala celebrated his first goal of the season by pointing to his head.

Musiala scored the opening goal for Bayern Munich against Bodø/Glimt in the Champions League on Thursday, reacting fast to pounce on a deflected pass from Harry Kane and fire the ball into the net in the 47th minute.

As he wheeled away to celebrate with teammate Aleksandar Pavlovic , Musiala appeared to look to the stands while repeatedly pointing at the side of his head.

Bayern's star attacking midfielder was making the most of his first start since he collapsed on the field in two preseason games in a row. That was the first public sign of a neurological condition which he and the club had known about since at least last season .

Musiala posted on social media that he had been diagnosed with "absence seizures caused by a neurological dysfunction" but that the condition wasn't a risk to his health and he intended to keep playing as before.

Still, he was out of Bayern's team for three games as he adapted to what coach Vincent Kompany called an increase in his medication, and the shock of having his condition revealed so publicly. Musiala returned to the field when he came off the bench in Saturday's 0-0 draw with Schalke in the Bundesliga.

Musiala's goal against Bodø/Glimt was his first in any competitive game since scoring in Germany 's 7-1 win over Curacao at the World Cup in June.

articles.title: FIFA rules complicate Richarlison's Tottenham Hotspur situation as Brazilian seeks exit
articles.summary: Richarlison has been left out of Tottenham Hotspur's 25-man Premier League squad and is said to be exploring his options, which could include seeking a poten...
articles.body:
Richarlison 's situation at Tottenham Hotspur continues to deteriorate, with the striker exploring legal avenues that could include terminating his contract as the Brazilian transfer window approaches its deadline.

The 29-year-old finds himself in an uncertain position at the North London club, having been omitted from Roberto De Zerbi's 25-man Premier League squad, rendering him unable to feature. Spurs were limited to naming just 17 non-homegrown players in their registered league squad, a situation that cannot be rectified until the next English transfer window opens.

De Zerbi revealed to football.london that Richarlison has repeatedly requested to leave the club this summer, prompting the Italian to select Xavi Simons ahead of the forward, despite the Dutchman facing several more months on the sidelines as he continues his rehabilitation from the anterior cruciate ligament injury sustained in April.

Richarlison and his representatives are reportedly examining his legal options, which could encompass filing a request to cancel his contract following his omission from Tottenham's Premier League squad, though it is understood that any such action would prove challenging.

This comes amid reported interest from the club he supported as a child - Vasco da Gama - with the Brazilian transfer window set to close on Friday in his home country.

The forward, who led Tottenham's scoring charts last campaign and featured in their season opener at Brentford , is under contract until next summer, though the club holds an option to extend that agreement by an additional year beyond the deal he penned upon his £60 million ($72.6 million) arrival from Everton in 2022.

He rejected a return to his previous club this summer as the financial terms weren't suitable and was connected with a transfer to Trabzonspor that ultimately fell through before the Turkish window closed.

Despite reports from his native country suggesting Richarlison had been relegated to Spurs' U21 setup and De Zerbi seemingly indicating he wasn't participating with his squad prior to Saturday's draw at Nottingham Forest , photographs from Tuesday have revealed the forward has been working with the senior team this week.

To listen to the latest episode of 'All Out Soccer' - CLICK HERE

There are stringent regulations regarding isolating players from a squad in modern soccer, which clubs are mindful of following several prominent cases in recent years.

Richarlison could face difficulties attempting to secure a contract termination at this point early in the campaign. Article 15 of the FIFA Regulations on the Status and Transfer of Players, which outlines when a player can terminate their contract prematurely due to sporting just cause, indicates: "An established professional who has, in the course of the season, appeared in fewer than ten per cent of the official matches in which his club has been involved may terminate his contract prematurely on the ground of sporting just cause.

"Due consideration shall be given to the player's circumstances in the appraisal of such cases. The existence of sporting just cause shall be established on a case-by-case basis. In such a case, sporting sanctions shall not be imposed, though compensation may be payable.

"A professional may only terminate his contract on this basis in the 15 days following the last official match of the season of the club with which he is registered."

Richarlison is reported to favor a short-term transfer to Vasco until the winter, but a loan arrangement is unavailable as Spurs have already hit their maximum of six outbound international loans.

Guglielmo Vicario , Pape Matar Sarr , Radu Dragusin , Souza, Kota Takai and Yang Min-hyeok all departed on loan this summer across Europe. The only exceptions permitted under FIFA's regulations apply to players aged 21 and under who are also club-trained, meaning Mikey Moore 's temporary move to Köln does not count toward their limit.

As a result, Vasco, or any other Brazilian club, would be required to secure Richarlison on a permanent basis to lure him away from North London. Official negotiations between Vasco and Tottenham regarding a transfer for the striker are not currently understood to be underway, with all attention now turning to the remaining days of the Brazilian transfer window.

articles.title: Lamine Yamal broke a Kylian Mbappé record during Barcelona’s win over Feyenoord
articles.summary: Barcelona star Lamine Yamal secured yet another piece of European football history for himself during the club’s latest outing. This came courtesy of his sta...
articles.body:
Barcelona star Lamine Yamal secured yet another piece of European football history for himself during the club's latest outing. This came courtesy of his starring performance in the Blaugrana 's meeting with Feyenoord.

Hansi Flick's troops of course got their continental campaign up and running in some style on Wednesday night. After welcoming Dutch outfit Feyenoord to Catalunya's capital, Barca kept alive an explosive opening to the season, courtesy of a 5-1 romp.

The aforementioned Lamine featured from the off in the fixture, and proved himself one of the standout performers…

From his berth on the right flank, the 19-year-old directly contributed to three of Barcelona's five goals, courtesy of a pair of assists, followed by a free-kick goal of his own.

And as alluded to above, in the process, Lamine took over ownership of yet another Champions League record. As revealed by statisticians Opta :

'Lamine Yamal now has 21 goal involvements in the UEFA Champions League (11 goals, 10 assists); the outright most by a teenager in the competition's history, overtaking Kylian Mbappé 's 20.'

This stat was posted immediately following Lamine's first assist of the evening on Wednesday, meaning he has in fact since taken his tally to 23.

articles.title: El Manchester United le da una cruel bienvenida al Sabah
articles.standfirst: Los 'diablos rojos' golearon a los debutantes tirando de eficacia
articles.summary: Los 'diablos rojos' golearon a los debutantes tirando de eficacia
articles.body: El Sabah, fundado en 2017, saltó a Old Trafford con personalidad. No parecía un debutante. Ni mucho menos. Sin embargo, el Manchester United le dio una cruel bienvenida. Los 'diablos rojos' tiraron de eficacia para derrotar al campeón de Azerbaiyán (3-0). El United, sin Rashford (suplente), cargaba el juego por derecha con Bryan Mbeumo y Noussair Mazraoui. Sin demasiado peligro, eso sí. Los visitantes, por su parte, generaban cierta incertidumbre con las internadas de Kaheem Parris. Los de Michael Carrick, huérfanos en la elaboración, aprovecharon la osadía del Sabah en salida para 'abrir la lata' en el 27'. Robó Bryan Mbeumo, centró Patrick Dorgu y marcó Matheus Cunha atacando el primer palo. Rozó el empate Joy Lance Mickels en el 36' con un cabezazo casi sobre la línea que se marchó al lateral de la red. Dos goles en tres minutos le bastaron a los 'diablos rojos' para dejar el partido visto para sentencia antes del descanso. Amplió distancias Bruno Fernandes en el 42'. Cunha filtró para Youri Tielemans y éste cedió atrás para que el 'MVP' de la pasada Premier marcara llegando de segunda línea. El 3-0, en el 45', llevó la firma de Benjamin Sesko, que aprovechó un pase en la espalda de Mbeumo para regatear a Stas Pokatilov y marcar a placer. El segundo tiempo comenzó con la misma tónica. El United llegaba sin peligro... pero al Sabah le costaba cada vez más salir. El 4-0 en el 68' supuso la puntilla. Marcó Lisandro Martínez con una gran dosis de suerte. Entre Pokatilov y Aden McCarthy se liaron a la hora de despejar un taconazo de Joshua Zirkzee y el argentino marcó a placer. Buen resultado para el United... y buena puesta en escena del Sabah.
